name: Box Up
summary: A Buy Now button that shows your order being picked, packed, taped, shipped and stamped
about: A product card with a small packing station above the Buy Now button. Pressing it makes the kettle wiggle, hop off the shelf and drop into a box with a puff of dust; paper fills it, the flaps spring shut, tape and a label stamp on, and the box rolls away on a running belt. A step tracker, a striped progress fill, a SHIPPED stamp and confetti follow along.
how: Press Buy Now: the kettle wiggles on its shelf
It hops off and drops into the open box with a puff of dust
Paper fills the box and the flaps spring shut
Tape runs down and a label stamps on
The belt runs and the box rolls away while the steps tick to Shipped
A SHIPPED stamp, confetti and a tracking number appear
A fresh empty box rolls in and the kettle drops back on the shelf
